name: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
type: museum; art museum; national academy; art academy
text: The Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando (RABASF; transl. Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando), located on the Calle de Alcalá in the centre of Madrid, currently functions as a museum and gallery. A public law corporation, it is integrated together with other Spanish royal academies in the Instituto de España.
